_note: The three slice blasters (GAME-09), keyed by id, in level order. Units: metres, seconds, degrees. Common fields, then one block for the fire mode: pump (primeTime), auto (fireInterval, spinUp, spinDown, recoil), break (fireInterval). A mod's fields override the blaster's; nested blocks (recoil) merge key by key. Starting values from the blaster cards, marked to tune on the range. Viewmodel placement numbers are first guesses; the reviewer sets them.

impact._note: PT-03: the shared distance half of the impact rule (src/foamers/impact.ts). near is 1 within fullMetres of the muzzle and falls in a straight line to 0 at zeroMetres; a blaster (B03) or a mod may carry its own impact block and override this. An explosion's kill ignores it and uses near 1. Start values for Paul to tune on the range.

chunk._note: GAME-09b: the slug is one heavy dart, so it carves a smaller hole than the Leviathan's close blast; PT-03 dropped rangeMetres (the impact rule reads its own distance now).

bounce._note: Every 5th shot bounces to another target: GAME-09b. Data only for now.

B06._note: GAME-09d: The Standard (design/blasters/B06.md). Heavy full-auto on mega darts: slower than B04, each shot much harder. The approved model has no flywheels: its moving part is bolt, so wheelSpin drives nothing and is left at 0. Start values for Paul to tune on the range.
B06.name: The Standard

rate._note: GAME-09d mod 1 (Paul): increased rate of fire, about 8 a second.

explosive._note: GAME-09d mod 2 (Paul): every 5th mega dart explodes where it first hits, through the shared ExplosionSystem. The count is on the blaster (Blaster.beginShot reads explosiveEvery).

B05._note: GAME-09e: Shrike (design/blasters/B05.md). Precision bolt action on precision darts: one dart, no spread, the bolt (primeTime) is the limit on the rate. pierce is on the dart type in data/darts.json. The approved model's moving part is bolt (the pump node of B01 is its own); the bolt's animation belongs to the viewmodel work (ART-05). Start values for Paul to tune on the range. zoom: the share of the player's own field of view while the zoom action is held, with the look sensitivity scaled the same way (src/game/zoom.ts).
B05.name: Shrike

explosive._note: GAME-09e mod 1 (Paul): every shot explodes where it first hits, through the shared ExplosionSystem (the count is on the blaster: Blaster.beginShot reads explosiveEvery).

heavy._note: GAME-09e mod 2 (Paul): heavier rounds: the precisionHeavy dart, which pierces three Foamers and hits a little harder.

chunk._note: GAME-09b: eight darts at once, close in. carveRadius is the hole's radius in metres at no impact, the biggest carve in the game (PT-03 dropped rangeMetres: the impact block now carries the distance). push multiplies the ragdoll's kill push.

impact._note: PT-03 (Paul: point blank shots did not feel nearly as catastrophic as desired): the Leviathan is the game's close-range weapon, so its darts count as point blank out to 3 m and fall to no impact at 12 m. With these, point blank one barrel on an F01 is a big pop and both barrels on an F05 chunk it. Start values for Paul to tune on the range.

B02._note: GAME-09c: semi-auto sidearm. The review pointed it at its own approved model (public/models/blasters/B02.glb, ART-04), which replaced the B01 placeholder with no code change.
B02.name: Musketeer

burst._note: GAME-09c: mod 1. One press fires three darts, burstGap apart, then the cooldown.

heavy._note: GAME-09c: mod 2, heavy rounds: slugs, slower firing, their own chunk: a bigger carve and push than the standard dart, smaller than B01's slug (PT-03 dropped rangeMetres: the impact rule reads distance itself). ART-05b: the mod's own motion: a bigger kick and a slower slide return (start values for Paul).

B07._note: GAME-09f: Collateral (design/blasters/B07.md). Pump-action single launcher round: slow, high arc, explodes where it first hits. Mod 1, remote: rounds stop where they hit and a fire press detonates them all. Mod 2, cluster: the blast throws four small ones around it. Start values for Paul to tune on the range.
B07.name: Collateral

B08._note: GAME-09g: Firehose (CONTENT-PLAN section 4, Paul: gatling, room-clearing 'final word', spins up to fire at an incredible rate, foam balls, 120 / 240, massive power, recoil, chaotic, ricochets, slows movement when firing). Placeholder model: B04's, whose flywheels already spin, until ART-01/ART-04 give B08 its own; the swap is this one line. fireMoveShare: while the trigger is held and the wheels are up to speed, the player walks and sprints at this share of their speed (src/game/game.ts feeds it to the controller's fireMoveScale, which multiplies in beside the shield's own slow, it does not replace it). Mod Twin names muzzle_1 twice: the placeholder model has one muzzle, so both barrels draw from the same node until B08's own model exists. Start values for Paul to tune on the range.
B08.name: Firehose

control._note: GAME-09g mod 1 (Paul): recoil control and reduced movement penalty: much less spread and climb, and the firing slow eased to 0.85.

twin._note: GAME-09g mod 2 (Paul): a second barrel for 2x fire rate: half the fireInterval, the auto shot alternating the two muzzles. Both entries name muzzle_1 until B08's own model exists (the placeholder has one muzzle).
